item.title: Master the Art of Asking for Referrals 🌟 • Be specific about the job and company you want. • Highlight your relevant skills and achievements. • Use: "I am excited about the role at X because of Y." • Offer to provide your updated resume or LinkedIn profile. • Express gratitude for their assistance. Who in your network could help you with a referral today? #networking #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
